meta.purpose: Flat keyword -> location map for quick-find/navigation. Look up a keyword name (e.g. 'COLOR') to see every level/category it appears under in iSDA's UI.

*AUTOENTNN.description: Auto-enter only when no numeric selection is possible

*AUTOSLTENH.description: Auto-select only with an enhanced controller

*NUMCOL.description: Arrange choices in this many columns

*NUMROW.description: Arrange choices in this many rows

*RSTCSR.description: Restrict cursor to the choice field

*SLTIND.description: Display a select indicator per choice

ALTNAME.description: Alternative record name for program-described-file I/O
ALTNAME.s36e: S36E-adjacent but NOT USRDSPMGT-conditional (verified): 1-8 chars, no leading '*', must be unique among all record/alternate names, not allowed on SFL. See S36-3 in LIMITATIONS-PLAN.md.

ASSUME.description: Assume record is already on display

CHANGE.s36e: S36E-conditional (record-level CHANGE only): a response indicator here triggers a WARNING when USRDSPMGT is present. Verified, S36-3/S36-4.
S36E-conditional (record-level CHANGE only): a response indicator here triggers a WARNING when USRDSPMGT is present. Verified, S36-3/S36-4.

CHCAVAIL.category: Menu-bar choice - Choice Colors and Attributes

CHCSLT.category: Menu-bar choice - Choice Colors and Attributes

CHCUNAVAIL.category: Menu-bar choice - Choice Colors and Attributes

CHECK.description: Allow blanks (AB) / move cursor right-left top-bottom (RLTB) / right to left (RL)
Allow blanks (AB) / move cursor right to left (RL)

Mandatory entry (ME) / auto record advance (ER) / mandatory fill (MF) / field exit required (FE) / right-adjust blank fill (RB) / right-adjust zero fill (RZ) / move cursor right-to-left (RL) / lowercase allowed (LC)
CHECK.parameters: ME | ER | MF | FE | RB | RZ | RL | LC

CHECK.description: Name-extended field (VNE) / name field (VN) / allow blanks (AB) / modulus-10 self-check (M10/M10F) / modulus-11 self-check (M11/M11F)
CHECK.parameters: VNE | VN | AB | M10 | M10F | M11 | M11F

CHGINPDFT.parameters: attribute codes, e.g. HI RI CS BL UL LC ME MF FE

CHOICE.description: Selection field choice - text/indicators for one choice number
CHOICE.parameters: choice-number indicators text-field 'text' (deliberately deferred: variable-argument Text-field/Return-field forms, only the literal-text form is modeled)

CLEAR.description: Indicator to clear the display, with optional descriptive text (Task I-4)

CLRL.description: Clear previous display from this line down

CNTFLD.description: Continued field - Task I-30 correction: this is a numeric column-width, not a field name

COLOR.parameters: BLU | GRN | PNK | RED | TRQ | WHT | YLW

CSRLOC.description: Hidden fields carrying cursor position for output

DATSEP.description: Date separator (data type L only) - cannot be specified with a fixed-separator DATFMT (*ISO/*USA/*EUR/*JIS)

DFTVAL.description: Default value, independently conditioned - Task I-30 correction: implemented as ONE conditionable occurrence, not a repeatable list (a field needs only a single default value; see the code's own deliberate-single-instance rationale)

DSPATR.parameters: HI RI CS BL ND UL PC MDT PR OID SP (each independently toggleable; Task I-30 corrected two stray values - UH/RE do not exist)

DSPSIZ.description: Supported display sizes (24x80 / 27x132), in priority order

EDTCDE.description: Edit code, optionally replacing leading zeros
EDTCDE.parameters: A-D, J-Q, W, Y, Z, 1-9; optional */$

ENTFLDATR.description: Default attribute for entry fields (referenced via entFldAtrHtml, shared with record-level)
Default attribute for entry fields in this record

ERASE.description: Erase all records below this one

ERRMSGID.parameters: indicators msgid file library indicator name

ERRSFL.description: Write error messages to a message subfile

FRCDTA.description: Force data out before buffer is full

GETRETAIN.description: Retain data on display if UNLOCK specified

HELP.description: Indicator for the Help key, with optional descriptive text (Task I-4)
HELP.s36e: S36E-conditional: a response indicator here triggers an ERROR (not just a warning) when USRDSPMGT is present - HLPRTN must also be specified to return control to the program. Verified, S36-3/S36-4.
S36E-conditional: a response indicator here triggers an ERROR (not just a warning) when USRDSPMGT is present - HLPRTN must also be specified to return control to the program. Verified, S36-3/S36-4.

HLPEXCLD.description: Exclude area from help text (Help-specification level)

HLPID.description: Constant help identifier (Task I-30: present in the code's own General Keywords row list for every field kind, but this index's Character category was missing it - only had it under 'Constant field additions' below)
Help ID for a constant field

HLPPNLGRP.description: Help text supplied by a UIM panel group
Help text supplied by a UIM panel group (Help-specification level, not record-level)

HLPRCD.description: Help record - names the record format containing the help text (Task I-5)

HLPRTN.description: Indicator for Help return, with optional descriptive text (Task I-4)
HLPRTN.s36e: S36E-conditional: required alongside HELP to return control to the application program when USRDSPMGT is present. Verified, S36-3/S36-4.
S36E-conditional: required alongside HELP to return control to the application program when USRDSPMGT is present. Verified, S36-3/S36-4.

HLPSCHIDX.description: Enable a search index for help

HLPTITLE.description: Help title text, repeatable/independently-conditioned instances up to 15/record - Task I-27

HOME.description: Indicator for the Home key, with optional descriptive text (Task I-4)

IGCCNV.description: DBCS conversion command-function key and line

INDARA.description: Use a separate indicator area instead of field-level indicators

INZRCD.description: Write record before issuing read if not already on display

KEEP.description: Keep record on display when file closes

KEYBRD.description: Keyboard shift attribute - value list depends on the field's data type (Task L59: character gets N/A/X/W/I/D/M/J/O/E/G, numeric gets S/N/Y/I/D)

MNUBAR.description: This record is a menu bar; option indicators are not valid for this keyword

MNUBARCHC.category: Menu-bar choices / Menu-bar separator field wiring
MNUBARCHC.description: This field is a menu-bar choice entry point

MNUBARDSP.description: Menu-bar display, repeatable/independently-conditioned instances (Task I-17); non-MNUBAR records get a 3-name record/choice/pull-down form, MNUBAR records get a single pull-down-input-field form
MNUBARDSP.parameters: parameters (optional, shape depends on record type)

MNUBARSW.description: Menu-bar switch key - mutually exclusive CA key with MNUCNL, checked across file- and record-level scopes (Task I-18)

MNUCNL.description: Menu-cancel key - mutually exclusive CA key with MNUBARSW, checked across file- and record-level scopes (Task I-18)

MOUBTN.description: Mouse button/event to command-key mapping (Task I-5)

MSGID.description: Message ID, optionally combined with a field/message-ID/message-number
MSGID.parameters: prefix, identifier [& field/msgid/msgnbr], file, library, indicators
MSGID.s36e: S36E-adjacent but NOT USRDSPMGT-conditional (verified): full MSGID(msg-id [lib/]msg-file)/MSGID(*NONE) syntax, including &field and special-value forms. See S36-3 in LIMITATIONS-PLAN.md.

MSGLOC.description: Message line row, primary and per-size-conditioned

OPENPRT.description: Leave print file open until display file is closed

PAGEDOWN.description: Indicator for Page down (legacy alias ROLLUP recognized), with optional descriptive text (Task I-4)

PAGEUP.description: Indicator for Page up (legacy alias ROLLDOWN recognized), with optional descriptive text (Task I-4)

PASSRCD.description: Record to pass unformatted data to/from

PRINT.description: Enable the Print key (also carries the *PGM / [library/]printer-file-name print-destination forms - Task I-2: PRTFILE is not a real DDS keyword, it's PRINT's own parameter)
PRINT.s36e: S36E-conditional: a NUMERIC response indicator triggers a WARNING when USRDSPMGT is present. PRINT(*PGM) is explicitly excluded - IBM's own PRINT(*PGM) S36E sub-page documents it as a valid, expected combination with a purely runtime, compiler-dependent behavior, not a warning. Verified, S36-3/S36-4.

PRINT.description: Enable the Print key (also carries the *PGM / [library/]printer-file-name print-destination forms - Task I-2: PRTFILE is not a real DDS keyword, it's PRINT's own parameter)
PRINT.s36e: S36E-conditional: a NUMERIC response indicator triggers a WARNING when USRDSPMGT is present. PRINT(*PGM) is explicitly excluded - IBM's own PRINT(*PGM) S36E sub-page documents it as a valid, expected combination with a purely runtime, compiler-dependent behavior, not a warning. Verified, S36-3/S36-4.

PULLDOWN.description: This record is a pull-down, with selection-indicator/cursor-restriction sub-flags

REF.description: Reference database file for field attributes

REFFLD.description: Reference field for attributes (implemented via the separate 'Resolve Referenced Field via Code for i' feature, not a plain getX/setX pair)

RETCMDKEY.s36e: S36E-adjacent but NOT USRDSPMGT-conditional (verified): same general rules as RETKEY, plus RETCMDKEY's own CAnn/CFnn mutual-exclusion rules. See S36-3 in LIMITATIONS-PLAN.md.

RETKEY.s36e: S36E-adjacent but NOT USRDSPMGT-conditional (verified): needs INDARA, ignored on first output op, not on SFL/USRDFN, incompatible with ALTHELP/ALTPAGEUP/ALTPAGEDWN, plus RETKEY's own mutual-exclusion rules. See S36-3 in LIMITATIONS-PLAN.md.

RETLCKSTS.description: Retain LOCK status on next read

RMVWDW.description: Remove existing windows before this record is displayed

RTNCSRLOC.description: Return cursor location to these hidden fields

RTNDTA.description: Return same input data on next read

SETOF.description: Set indicator(s) off when this record is used

SFLCSRRRN.description: Subfile cursor relative record number field

SFLCTL.description: This is a subfile control record, naming its related SFL

SFLENTER.description: Use Enter key instead of a command key to process the subfile

SFLMLTCHC.description: Multiple-choice selection list - mutually exclusive with SFLSNGCHC and with SFLDROP/SFLFOLD (Task I-26)
SFLMLTCHC.parameters: [&number-selected] [*RSTCSR|*NORSTCSR] [*SLTIND] - RSTCSR default flips when the record is in a pull-down

SFLMSGKEY.category: Subfile Message record (SFLMSG record type) - Message Record
SFLMSGKEY.description: Message ID field (program builds queue one message at a time)

SFLMSGRCD.category: Subfile Message record (SFLMSG record type) - Message Record
SFLMSGRCD.description: Line number for the first message, conditioned by display size, with roll

SFLNXTCHG.description: Return this record on read next changed

SFLPAG.description: Number of records per display page - numeric only, no field-name form (Task I-22 correction)

SFLPGMQ.category: Subfile Message record (SFLMSG record type) - Message Record
SFLPGMQ.description: Program message queue field, or generate a 276-byte field

SFLSCROLL.description: Return top-of-subfile record number on scroll - cannot share a field with SFLRCDNBR/SFLROLVAL, only one per record (Task I-26)

SFLSIZ.description: Number of records in the subfile - a program-to-system field name cannot be combined with a display-size-conditioned instance (Task I-22)
SFLSIZ.parameters: number | field name, or per-DSPSIZ-size (*DS3/*DS4/...) instances

SFLSNGCHC.description: Single-choice selection list - mutually exclusive with SFLMLTCHC and with SFLDROP/SFLFOLD (Task I-26)
SFLSNGCHC.parameters: [*RSTCSR|*NORSTCSR] [*SLTIND] [*AUTOSLT|*NOAUTOSLT|*AUTOSLTENH] - RSTCSR/AUTOSLT defaults flip when the record is in a pull-down

TEXT.description: Documentation text - no compiled/runtime effect (Task I-30: was missing from this index entirely)

TIMFMT.description: Time format (data type T only) - no *JOB value, unlike DATFMT

TIMSEP.description: Time separator (data type T only) - cannot be specified with a fixed-separator TIMFMT (*ISO/*USA/*EUR/*JIS)

USRDSPMGT.s36e: S36E gating keyword. When present, restricts CHANGE/HELP/HLPRTN/PRINT - the only 3 (4 counting HLPRTN) actually gated by USRDSPMGT. ALTNAME/MSGID/RETKEY/RETCMDKEY are verified but NOT USRDSPMGT-conditional - they're general rules IBM documents alongside the S36E material. See S36-3 in LIMITATIONS-PLAN.md.

USRRSTDSP.description: Program handles display restore around this window

VLDCMDKEY.description: Indicator for an invalid command key, with optional descriptive text (Task I-4)
Indicator for an invalid command key

WDWBORDER.description: Default window border color/display-attributes/characters for the whole file

WDWBORDER.category: Border Parameters / Border Color / Border Display Attributes / Border Characters
WDWBORDER.description: Window border color / display attributes / 8-position border characters

WINDOW.description: Window definition or reference to another window
